name: On-delay timer relay
summary: An on-delay timer postpones a specified output transition after its timing condition becomes active.
description: An on-delay timer postpones a specified output transition after its timing condition becomes active. The timing input, auxiliary supply and delayed output must be distinguished in the schematic.
readingNotes: Read the timing diagram to establish when the interval starts and how interruption resets it.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: On-delay postpones the specified transition on operation; off-delay postpones a transition after removal of the initiating condition.
